summary: Insurance Product Information Document for the comprehensive (all-risks) insurance for personal property included in the easyPROTECT product, headed "Comprehensive insurance for personal property" and issued under the brand "LALUX Assurances". Within the limits of the Special Conditions it covers loss, damage or material damage to the insured objects where the risk results from theft, fire, explosions, damage caused by water or an exclusively accidental cause. The policyholder chooses which categories of object are insured among musical instruments, cameras and similar devices, jewellery and furs, private collections of postage stamps, and cycles. Cover applies worldwide unless the General Terms and Conditions stipulate otherwise.

gaps: CARRIER UNDETERMINABLE. The document prints only the brand "LALUX Assurances" (header line "LALUX Assurances - Product : easyPROTECT Comprehensive") and refers to the insurer in the body as "the Company" / "the company". No legal form, no RCS number, no address and no supervisor are printed anywhere on the two pages. lalux is two separately authorised entities (LA LUXEMBOURGEOISE S.A., non-life, and LA LUXEMBOURGEOISE-VIE S.A., life), and naming neither does not allow one to be chosen. insurer_name is copied through from the task metadata as "lalux" and no legal entity is asserted.

BRANCH DISAGREEMENT (flagged for review). The task metadata gives branch=multirisque-professionnelle and it has been copied through unchanged, but the document itself is an all-risks cover for personal property (musical instruments, cameras, jewellery and furs, private stamp collections, cycles) sold as part of easyPROTECT, and it refers to "the policyholder, a member of their family" and to "Student housing". Nothing in the document describes a professional or business risk. Within the allowed Luxembourg slugs, habitation or autres would fit the printed content better than multirisque-professionnelle.

LAYOUT DEFECT, verified on a render at 3x. The "What is not insured ?" list is split across two boxes and the second half is printed ABOVE its own heading: the top-right grey box of page 1 (text-layer blocks at x 307-568, y 256-455) carries the categories "Private collections of postage stamps", "Cycles" and "In general" with no heading of its own, in the position where a reader expects the continuation of "What is insured ?". The render shows those items carry the red cross (X) marker used for exclusions, not the green tick used in the "What is insured ?" box, so all seven have been recorded as exclusions. The text layer emits that box before the "What is not insured ?" heading, which reproduces the printed order.

INTERNAL CONTRADICTION, printed as such and preserved verbatim. Under "Are there any restrictions on cover?" the document states: "Irreparable cycles: compensation equal to the replacement value less the replacement value." Read literally this yields nil compensation and contradicts the preceding sentence, which uses "the difference between the replacement value and the salvage value". Confirmed on a render that the page really prints "less the replacement value"; it has NOT been corrected. The reading the sibling-language versions may carry has not been imported.

TENSION BETWEEN CLAIM DEADLINES, recorded as printed without arbitration. "What are my obligations ?" requires claims to be declared "within eight days of their occurrence", but for theft or loss requires notification by registered letter "within 24 hours", and for theft a complaint to the competent authorities "within 12 hours" - i.e. the complaint deadline expires before the notification deadline. All three are recorded separately in claims_procedure.

edition_date is null: no edition date, version code or reference number is printed on either page. The PDF's own metadata carries the InDesign file name "IPID_Tous Risques relative aux biens_LALUX_EN.indd" and a creation date of 2021-05-06, but neither is printed on the document and neither has been promoted into edition_date or reference.
target_audience is null: the document nowhere states a target public. The wording that bears on it is recorded in target_audience_note and has not been converted into a value.

No deductible / franchise is stated anywhere, so deductibles is null. The nearest thing is the under-insurance rule recorded in special_conditions, under which the insured "is considered to be their own insurer for the excess and bears a proportional share of the damage" - that is a proportional under-insurance rule, not a franchise, and has not been recorded as one.
No waiting period and no prescription period are stated; both left empty/null rather than inferred.

The "What is insured ?" box opens with "with the exception of the elements expressly excluded by the General Conditions" and both exclusion boxes are closed by the label "Non-exhaustive list". The General Conditions are not part of this document, so the exclusion list here is by the document's own admission incomplete.

is_extension has been set to false. The document says the cover is "included in the easyPROTECT product" - i.e. a module of a package - but it is never described as an option, extension or rider, so it has not been recorded as one. product_family=easyPROTECT and variant=Comprehensive record the relationship instead.

Character notes for downstream consumers: the text layer contains U+2009 THIN SPACE (11 occurrences) before "?" in the section headings, before ":" in the header product line, and inside the percentages "10 %" and "80 %"; and U+2019 in "policyholder’s" and "company’s". All key_quotes were sliced programmatically as exact spans and preserve these characters. The prompt text was verified byte-identical to page.get_text("text") of the local PDF for both pages before extraction; the text was not truncated (2 pages).

Optionality: the five object categories are marked is_optional=true on the strength of the printed phrase "The comprehensive insurance covers, at your choice, the following risks". The document gives no formula/tier table and states no sum insured for any category; sums insured are left to the Special Conditions, which are not part of this document.
